unreachable.SELLER_FEE_EXCEEDS_PRINCIPAL: fee = min(P * rate / 10000, cap) and rate <= 10000 is enforced by the preceding range check, so fee <= P always holds and a cap can only lower it further. The branch becomes reachable only if the rate ceiling is ever relaxed above 100%.
unreachable.CONSERVATION_MISMATCH: buyerDebit == sellerCredit + collectorCredit is an algebraic identity under the current formulas; the branch exists to catch implementation drift, not reachable input.
